_note: A real published Watch Dogs 2 episode (Part 10) - match this voice and shape, not its content.
title: Falling Back On The Aiden Pearce Method
cold_why: Him deciding he is done being quiet and walking straight at them. It has movement and a real reaction under it, and it sets up the whole episode, where the stealth plan keeps collapsing. The higher scoring candidates are a pawn shop chat and a plot phone call, neither of which shows anything.
description:
Part 10. The server job turns loud the moment the jumper gets spotted, and once quiet has stopped working I go back to what the first Watch Dogs taught me. Walk up, put everybody on the floor, tidy up afterwards.

The rest of the building is a camera puzzle I could not see the answer to for a good while, a floor I ended up reaching twice by two different routes, and a system that lets me open the floodgates and alert private security in the same button press.

What comes out of that server is the actual point of it. Home bundles up what people do at home and sells access to other companies, mostly health insurance, so order too much pizza and your premium climbs while they take a cut of it.

Then a quiet drive out past a pawn shop and down a bus lane that has never once had a bus in it.
chapters: And their security, at the same time
They sell it to health insurance
No buses in the bus lane
